evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce MemToC, a controlled benchmark for post-tool-return arbitration with executable tools.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: MemToC comprises 6,504 evaluation episodes constructed from 542 quality-controlled factual questions, independently elicited model-specific closed-book answers, and controlled tool returns of known correctness.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We compare prompting with SFT and DPO using chain-level cross-fitting over ToolHop, so questions sharing an underlying fact never straddle training and evaluation.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Correctness-conditioned arbitration can be improved through fine-tuning, but gains must be evaluated jointly with correct tool use, abstention, and robustness to formulation.
